scenario_summary: Customer is requesting a refund for a service canceled 34 days ago, which falls outside the standard 30-day refund window.

conversation.message: Hi, my name is Diego Martinez and I'm 38. I'm trying to get a refund for a service I canceled 34 days ago. I know your refund policy is usually 30 days, but I was traveling and only just saw the charge — I didn't realize it had gone through until now. Is there anything you can do?

Hello Diego, thank you for reaching out. I understand how frustrating it can be to return from travel and find an unexpected charge. I would be happy to look into this for you. To get started, could you please provide the email address associated with your account and the last four digits of the payment method used?
Sure, the email is d.martinez@email.com and the card ends in 4492.

Thank you, Diego. I have successfully verified your account. I see the subscription cancellation was processed on the 34th day prior to today. Our 'Standard Billing & Refund Policy' (Section 4.2) stipulates a 30-day window for full refunds. However, I can see that you have been a loyal member for three years with no prior billing disputes.
I appreciate you looking at my history. I really didn't use the service during that time since I was out of the country.

I appreciate that context. While I cannot automatically process a refund outside the 30-day window, I have the authority to issue a 'Loyalty Exception' refund for long-term members in specific circumstances. I have verified your account status and am processing the refund for the charge of $49.99 now.
That would be a huge help, thank you so much for understanding.

You are very welcome, Diego. I have successfully issued the refund to your card ending in 4492. You should see the credit reflect on your statement within 3-5 business days depending on your financial institution. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?

resolution_summary: The agent verified the customer's account and long-term history, then applied a 'Loyalty Exception' to override the 30-day refund policy, successfully processing the refund.

judge_scores.justification: The agent conducted appropriate verification and demonstrated exceptional empathy by acknowledging the customer's travel situation. Furthermore, the agent efficiently utilized their authority to apply a specific policy exception ('Loyalty Exception') without needing an unnecessary escalation.
